searchText: apologies if this has been asked, but when is the call deciding on London HF block numbers is taking place? and ofc i ask this on the wrong ethX channel, apologies squared <#745077610685661265> and the calls are every other Friday (next one in about 12 hours or so, don't quote me on that exact time). thank you! is that the call in which the hf block numbers would be decided on tho? When runtime verification carried out their analysis of the deposit contract they included gas costs (specifically, for my purposes, the maximum gas cost of the `deposit` call) in section 4 of https://raw.githubusercontent.com/runtimeverification/deposit-contract-verification/master/deposit-contract-verification.pdf I assume these numbers will have changed with the Berlin hardfork. Could the EF perhaps ping runtime verification to provide an update, so this new maximum value can be used when depositing?

excerpts.author: jgm
excerpts.content:
When runtime verification carried out their analysis of the deposit contract they included gas costs (specifically, for my purposes, the maximum gas cost of the `deposit` call) in section 4 of https://raw.githubusercontent.com/runtimeverification/deposit-contract-verification/master/deposit-contract-verification.pdf  

I assume these numbers will have changed with the Berlin hardfork.  Could the EF perhaps ping runtime verification to provide an update, so this new maximum value can be used when depositing?
